data.name: Virtual Crime Scene - Apartment 213
data.detailed_description:
In the final minutes of July 22 1991, Milwaukee police were led to 924 N 25th Street Apartment 213 by a man who claimed he was threatened and handcuffed by the resident. Discoveries made during a preliminary search of the residence resulted in an arrest and investigation that would define one of the most difficult chapters in the city’s history. This is a digital reconstruction of that residence as it appeared at the time of the initial investigation, based on photographs, reports, trial records, and recovered evidence. Objects within the space include contextual information drawn from investigative documentation, detailing what was known during the investigation and what was later established. The purpose of this project is documentation, study, and preservation. Viewer discretion is advised.

Intended Audience:

Researchers and students of criminology, forensic science, or criminal history.

True crime enthusiasts interested in detailed, authentic reconstructions.

Anyone seeking a digital preservation of a historically documented crime scene.

Controls:

Keyboard/Mouse: WASD to navigate, I and O to zoom, spacebar to toggle Forensic View

Gamepad: Analog sticks to navigate, bumpers to zoom, b (right button) to toggle Forensic View

data.short_description: An explorable digital reconstruction of 924 N 25th Street Apartment 213 in Milwaukee, WI as seen on the early morning hours of July 23, 1991. The environment reflects the residence as it appeared at the time, based on photographs, reports, trial records, and recovered evidence.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX-8350 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070 (8 GB VRAM) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: High-resolution photo textures and realistic lighting can push VRAM usage to ~8 GB. Running on an SSD significantly reduces texture pop-in and load-in stutter. Windows x64 only at launch; Linux/macOS support coming soon.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

content_descriptors.notes: This experience contains references to real-life violence and criminal acts. It is a forensic reconstruction of a crime scene tied to a high-profile serial killer case. While it does contain censored nude imagery, it does not feature gore or explicit visuals. However, the subject matter may be disturbing to some users.
